Messages.Author: L. Scott Johnson
Messages.Body:
****************
Posted from my Civilian Account
****************

"John M. Baker" <fau...@psu.edu> writes:
>If you want to hurt everyone, Screw the Masquerade! is a good choice.

Screw the Masquerade is just a watered down Conservative Agitation,
only with a penalty:

Screw deals X points in an explicit way that virtually no one
will be inclined to vote in your favor on. Plus it deals 1
point to you.

ConsAg deals X points in any manner you choose, so that you can
distribute the points to gain external votes if you need to,
or you can focus most of the points on your Prey if you want.
And it doesn't deal any points to you unless you wish it to.

Screw is only better than ConsAg when only 2 players remain.

--
